newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak shipbuilder Komorno to launch bonds in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Slovak shipbuilder Komorno to launch bonds in 1997.

text.p: Slovakia's sole shipbuilder Slovenske Lodenice Komarno a.s. (SL) said on Monday it would issue two tranches of five-year bonds totalling 500 million crowns next year.
The first, 300 million crown tranche will be issued in convertible bonds, while the remaining 200 million crown issue will be launched as standard bonds, SL said in a statement.
"The company's extraordinary shareholders' meeting on Monday approved the issue of two tranches of five-year bonds next year," the statement said.
Funds from the issues will be used to help finance SL's development programmes. No further details were disclosed and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
